description: Whether a field will do as the IFR alternate at its ETA (14 CFR 91.169(c)): the standard minimums 600 ft and 2 sm with a precision approach (ILS, GLS, PAR; (c)(1)(i)(A)), 800 and 2 without ((B)); `good` null where the pilot has to look (its own minimums, no approach, no TAF at the ETA, a ceiling of unknown height, no visibility). A private or military-only field (private, military) is the pilot's to check too, with "KMXF is military: prior permission required (PPR)." or the owner's permission said.
